description: University of Arizona and HES-SO researchers publish PanTaGruEl as a dynamical model of the continental European transmission grid. Its own Zenodo description identifies network-bus demand allocation, line electrical parameters, merit-order generation dispatch and dynamic parameters for generators and loads. A ZIP release supplies extended Matpower and raw CSV data together with optimal-power-flow, spectral-analysis and minimal dynamics examples. It is freely available under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a published European grid representation, with time evolution determined by the simulated disturbance, not an observational time series. The case supports propagation and transient-stability simulations with model-matpower. A caveat is that its parameterisation and source inventories represent an approximate research model, not a current operator-validated network. Example results and transfer to other numerical environments require independent checks. The separately published Julia model builder has its own terms and is not assigned this archive licence. No archive or scripts were downloaded or executed.
